# AI Daily Digest — 2026-06-09

## 今日のハイライト
- **ゲノムAIの評価基準問題が露呈**: GENEB(42upvotes)が40モデル・100タスクで統一評価し、単一ランキングの誤解を実証。ゲノム基盤モデル研究のパラダイムシフトとなる可能性が高い
- **Claude Code v2.1.169リリース**: `--safe-mode`フラグと`/cd`コマンドが追加。エンタープライズMCPポリシーの重大バグも修正され、本番環境での安定性が向上
- **LLMの「分布サンプリング」に大きな欠陥**: UnpredictaBench(12upvotes)が448問題のKS@N評価で、主要LLMが真のランダム分布に従えないことを定量的に初めて実証


## Claude Code / Anthropic アップデート

### v2.1.169 (2024-06-08)

**主要機能**
- `--safe-mode` フラグ追加
- `/cd` コマンド追加
- `disableBundledSkills` 設定追加

**バグ修正**
- 上下矢印履歴ジャンプ問題を修正
- エンタープライズMCPポリシー未適用問題を修正

papers.title: GENEB: Why Genomic Models Are Hard to Compare
papers.abstract: Large-scale diagnostic benchmark evaluating frozen representations from 40 genomic foundation models across 100 tasks under unified probing protocol.

papers.title: Robots Need More than VLA and World Models
papers.abstract: Position paper identifying four missing components for robot intelligence.

papers.title: UnpredictaBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Distributional Randomness in LLMs
papers.abstract: Evaluation testing LLMs ability to capture true underlying distributions through 448 problems and KS@N metric.

papers.title: SPACENUM: Revisiting Spatial Numerical Understanding in VLMs
papers.abstract: Framework evaluating how vision-language models map spatial structure to numerical representations.

papers.title: Almieyar-Oryx-BloomBench
papers.abstract: Bilingual English-Arabic benchmark grounded in Bloom's Taxonomy evaluating six cognitive levels.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from Rich Feedback with Distributional DAgger
papers.abstract: Forward cross-entropy objective enabling monotonic policy improvement in reasoning tasks.

papers.title: LayerRoute: Input-Conditioned Adaptive Layer Skipping via LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Lightweight adapter that selectively skips transformer blocks based on input type.

papers.title: A Cookbook of 3D Vision
papers.abstract: Data-centric taxonomy connecting geometric representations, datasets, learning frameworks.

papers.title: Data-Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Models via On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation method transforming autoregressive models into diffusion language models.

papers.title: Imaginative Perception Tokens Enhance Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract: Intermediate perceptual representations that externalize model perceptions under alternative spatial configurations.

cc_updates.body: Added --safe-mode flag, /cd command, disableBundledSkills setting. Fixed arrow key history and MCP policy enforcement.
